purpose: Post-v4 weather integration requested by user
selection_window: May 2016, reused development data; not a fresh holdout
fixed_model: Same XGBoost capacity and calendar recursion as frozen v4; add six weather fields only
weather_input: ERA5 reanalysis at origin UTC hour minus 3 hours, held fixed throughout recursion
weather_availability_limitation: Reanalysis is retrospective; the three-hour timestamp lag does not certify historical publication availability. No future target-hour weather is used.
gate: Deploy as default only if May cumulative 48-step WAPE improves by at least 0.1 percentage point over the matched no-weather control. Otherwise keep v4 default and offer explicit experimental weather mode.
june_role: Spent diagnostic evidence only; no candidate or threshold selection on June
